description: Edit an uploaded image: rotate, flip, crop (pixels or aspect ratio), resize (width/height, percent, megapixels), grayscale (black & white), sepia, brightness, contrast, warm, cool, invert, blur, sharpen — applied in order. Optionally change the format (jpeg/png/webp) or make the file at most max_kb kilobytes (1 KB = 1,000 bytes). Creates a NEW image with its own page_url, image_url and download_url; the original stays unchanged.

id.description: Image id returned by upload_image or edit_image (e.g. "vqSvesFU")

max_kb.description: Largest file size in KB, 1 KB = 1,000 bytes (jpeg/webp)

aspect.description: crop: centered crop to a ratio like "1:1", "4:5", "16:9"

height.description: crop height, or resize target height (keeps proportions)

width.description: crop width, or resize target width (keeps proportions)

return_preview.description: Also return a small preview of the image so you can look at it (default false)

name: edit_image
title: Edit image
